answer.submission_route: The denial letter does not state a mailing address, fax number, website, or other submission method. Contact the member-services number on the insurance ID card and request the appeal address and submission instructions for reference number POC-D5606CAED3-36942. If this is a Banner|Aetna insured commercial plan, Banner|Aetna publicly states that members may file an appeal through its online form or by mailing or faxing its Member Complaint and Appeal Form: https://www.banneraetna.com/en/legal-notices/complaints-grievances-appeals.html. Confirm that route with the number on the ID card before submitting.
answer.how_to_obtain_criteria: Request, in writing and through Member Services or the appeals department, the complete medical policy and clinical review criteria used for CPT 29827, including the policy title and number, version and effective date, all rotator-cuff-repair medical-necessity criteria, the imaging criteria, the clinical-reviewer's rationale, and the records relied upon. Ask whether the review was delegated to eviCore and, if so, request the exact eviCore guideline version applied. The publicly indexed Banner 2026 prior-authorization grid lists CPT 29827 under eviCore, but the Banner document could not be retrieved because the site returned a Cloudflare access block. The publicly available eviCore document titled "CMM-315: Shoulder Surgery—Arthroscopic and Open Procedures" was located and its search listing includes CPT 29827, but I could not verify that this particular version governed this Banner plan and the August 2026 determination.
answer.notes: The appeal deadline is stated directly in the notice: 180 days from 2026-08-22, by 2027-02-18. I could not responsibly identify a specific governing policy containing the criteria applied to this patient. The notice says only that the determination was made under the plan's applicable medical policy and clinical review criteria; it does not name the policy or the reviewing entity. Banner's publicly indexed 2026 authorization grid identifies eviCore for CPT 29827, but that grid was inaccessible during retrieval, and the available eviCore guideline could not be text-extracted or confirmed as the version applicable on the notice date.
